purpose: chapter map only, no UI comp
prompt: Create a production-ready original background asset for a landscape mobile creature-collecting RPG chapter map. Image only, no interface, no text, no numbers, no logos, no characters. Wide 16:9 composition, high overhead three-quarter orthographic camera, hand-painted Japanese mobile RPG environment, clean cel-painted shapes and convincing small architectural details, polished game art rather than photorealism. One continuous region: a little coastal starter town in lower left with warm coral roofs and ivory walls, winding light sand road through a green meadow in the left middle, a bridge crossing a clear cyan river near center, dense rounded forest groves across middle and upper center, an abandoned small stone warehouse near center-right with dark slate roof, a rocky rise and a modest circular stone gym with coral doors on upper right. A clear S-shaped walking route links the town to the gym across the full width; leave open patches of ground along that route for overlaying ten stage pins. Scale: houses small enough that the journey across the whole region is legible, trees and boulders support the path rather than obscure it. Rich natural greens, cyan water, coral architecture accents, warm cream paths and soft navy-blue shadows, cheerful daylight from upper left. Crisp edges and layered painted texture at restrained scale, strongly readable silhouettes at phone size. No UI panels, no fake game cards, no promotional phone framing, no floating icons, no huge decorative monsters, no letters. The map fills the frame with land except a narrow coastline in lower left; no vast empty sky.
